EXTERNAL LIBRARIES (drop-in folder, same pattern as the course template)
GLFW / GLAD   : window, input and OpenGL loader (from the course template)
assimp/       : ONLY if using external models. Built from source with Visual Studio CMake; copy include/, .lib and .dll here (see Lab 4 manual).
freetype/     : ONLY if using FreeType for text (or use a bitmap font instead).
audio library : ONLY for the bonus (miniaudio / irrKlang / SoLoud).
